source: Yahoo Finance delayed NIFTY 50 price-index history (^NSEI)

assumptions.execution: Forecast after close t; execute at close t+1; first return earned t+1 to t+2
assumptions.weights: Inverse rolling 252-session RMSE, blended 25% with equal weights
assumptions.intervals: Rolling absolute out-of-sample residual quantiles using only completed five-session targets
